title: The Southern Pinwheel
credit: ESO/IDA/Danish 1.5 m/R. Gendler, S. Guisard and C. Thöne
displayModel: The photograph's light is decomposed into a midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 347 pc (S4G's disc scale length over 7.3, Kregel et al. 2002). Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher Large JPEG; no crop or resample.
